svg.title: Proof: 50% lower cloud costs for a production platform (PlutoSec, Toronto); 24K+ people reached by one product launch (Tadabbur on LinkedIn); 100% job success with international clients (Upwork); 2+ yrs shipping production software (Startups to government).
